projects.title: E-Library Landing Page
projects.tagline: Landing page dan antarmuka perpustakaan digital interaktif
projects.description: Landing page platform perpustakaan digital, dikerjakan sebagai proyek magang UI/UX dan Front-End di Penerbit Erlangga. Halaman memperkenalkan koleksi e-book melalui marquee sampul, enam blok fitur, bagian manfaat, testimoni, dan tautan unduh aplikasi. Dibangun dengan React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, dan Lenis untuk pergerakan halaman yang halus.
features: Marquee sampul buku berjalan sebagai pembuka halaman utama
Enam blok fitur produk dengan animasi masuk dan hover berbasis Framer Motion
Carousel testimoni serta bagian unduh App Store dan Play Store
Scroll halus dengan Lenis dan ilustrasi Lottie sebagai pendukung visual
Tata letak responsif dari layar ponsel hingga desktop

projects.title: Flowerful Website
projects.tagline: Katalog bunga interaktif dengan prototipe Figma yang dapat ditelusuri
projects.description: Perancangan UI/UX untuk katalog bunga interaktif. Pengunjung menelusuri koleksi buket dan dekorasi floral, membuka detail tiap item, dan berpindah antarhalaman lewat prototipe Figma yang dapat diklik. Fokus pengerjaan pada struktur katalog, konsistensi komponen, dan kejelasan navigasi.
features: Struktur katalog untuk menelusuri koleksi buket dan dekorasi floral
Halaman detail item dengan galeri visual dan pilihan varian
Prototipe alur navigasi yang dapat diklik dari beranda ke halaman detail
Sistem komponen dan token desain yang konsisten di seluruh halaman
Pratinjau interaktif langsung melalui kanvas Figma Embed

highlights: Kurikulum inti: Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak, Struktur Data & Algoritma, Pemrograman Web
Penerapan prinsip modularitas komponen, clean code, dan dokumentasi teknis terstruktur
Penyelesaian proyek aplikasi praktis berbasis antarmuka pengguna interaktif

projects.title: E-Library Landing Page
projects.tagline: Interactive digital library landing page and interface
projects.description: A digital library landing page built during my UI/UX and Front-End internship at Penerbit Erlangga. The page introduces the e-book collection through a cover marquee, six feature blocks, a benefits section, testimonials, and app download links. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lenis for smooth page movement.
features: A moving book cover marquee opens the main page
Six product feature blocks with Framer Motion entrance and hover animations
Testimonial carousel plus App Store and Play Store download sections
Smooth scrolling with Lenis and Lottie illustrations as visual support
Responsive layout from phone screens to desktop

projects.title: Flowerful Website
projects.tagline: Interactive flower catalog with a walkable Figma prototype
projects.description: UI/UX design for an interactive flower catalog. Visitors browse a collection of bouquets and floral arrangements, open each item's details, and move between pages through a clickable Figma prototype. The work focused on catalog structure, component consistency, and clear navigation.
features: Catalog structure for browsing bouquet and floral decoration collections
Item detail pages with a visual gallery and variant options
A clickable navigation flow prototype from home to detail pages
A component system and design tokens consistent across all pages
Live interactive preview through a Figma embed canvas

highlights: Core curriculum: Software Engineering, Data Structures & Algorithms, Web Programming
Applied component modularity, clean code, and structured technical documentation
Completed practical application projects with interactive user interfaces
